novelty.justification: The claim predicts that, at matched initial misalignment, "directly ablating the shared toxic-persona direction removes both channels comparably" while content-based re-alignment leaves a larger subliminal residual, so its novelty route is a channel-specific mechanistic relationship rather than merely a new setting. Searches for "subliminal misalignment benign re-alignment removability," "emergent versus subliminal misalignment data-mediated transfer," and "toxic persona direction ablation" identified the closest work as Emergent and Subliminal Misalignment Through the Lens of Data-Mediated Transfer (arXiv:2605.12798), alongside Conditional Misalignment (2026) and Inoculation Prompting (2025), which respectively cover the two transmission channels, hidden residual misalignment after benign interventions, and mitigation of subliminal trait transfer. Moving from those works to a matched-channel comparison contrasting content-based repair with direct persona-direction ablation is a substantive multi-step operationalization, but still a natural extension using established phenomena and interventions rather than a new core interpretability paradigm.
